name: mirage
text: Sorry, I should have answered sooner. Two things. (1) Legs with no result: Novig only keeps a leg's result for a short while, then drops the market, so most finished legs showed nothing. I built a fix: the engine now reads the game's final score and marks each finished game-line leg itself (spread, moneyline, total). It's tested and the engine is restarting with it now; expect results to appear on the Parlays screen within about 10-15 minutes. Player-prop legs may still stay blank. (2) The green lines: you're the one SELLING each parlay to a buyer, so the colors are from your side. A leg the buyer LOST is green (it kills their parlay, good for you). A leg the buyer WON is amber (brings them closer to winning, bad for you). Grey = not started or in play. I know that's backwards from how you'd naturally read it; if you'd like, I'll relabel them as 'good for you / bad for you' in plain words in the next app update.
